summary: ATA Creativity Global (the registrant) filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval of the sale of its direct and indirect subsidiaries, ATA BVI and a 69.0417% interest in Beijing Huanqiuyimeng, to Robox Holding Limited for nominal cash consideration of RMB1. The sale was approved by 99.8% of votes cast. Separately, shareholders approved a PIPE subscription agreement for 45,306,792 common shares at $0.46667/share, raising $21.1M. The transactions close concurrently. Watch for regulatory clearance and the PIPE's impact on liquidity.
